 "data": "@startuml
title End-to-End System Workflow

skinparam backgroundColor white
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam defaultFontName Arial

start

:User submits query;

:API receives request;

:LangGraph Orchestrator;

:Task decomposition;

:RAG retrieval;

fork
 :Search Qdrant;
fork again
 :Query Neo4j;
end fork

:Build evidence context;

fork
 :Fact verification;
fork again
 :Citation verification;
fork again
 :Logic / contradiction check;
end fork

:Reliability evaluation;

if (Reliable?) then (Yes)

 :Generate response;
 :Store result / audit;
 :Return final response;

else (No)

 :Trigger self-repair;
 :Re-plan task;
 :Retrieve additional evidence;
 :Run verification again;

 :Reliability evaluation;

 if (Reliable?) then (Yes)
 :Generate response;
 :Store result / audit;
 :Return final response;
 else (No)
 :Return low-confidence response;
 endif

endif

stop
